g.data-flaw: The huge original headline ghosts behind a smaller reset one, and the venue splits across its two sizes at the wrong words.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: the headline band is only partly detected (letters over the light beams), so its blanking and size fall short; the split should follow the band widths.
